items.note: White greeting header with a crescent-shaded yolk disc and sparkle, an ink Refresh pill on its ledge, a row of four saturated stat tiles (yolk, blue, green, orange), and cream chart and activity panels sized to their content. This is the reference's dashboard recipe, and the rc.1 live-feed defect is gone. The stat numbers are about 32px against the reference's dominant 64px figures (08), and the white-plated tile icons (calendar, clock) read as a stock icon set, not the flat shape kit.

Same language on the phone: 2×2 saturated tiles and a full-width ink pill. But the first screen spends two rows on chrome (cream nav-pill strip, then search + Search pill + avatar) before the greeting, and the disc pushes the title into a narrow indented column. The reference phone (04) has one compact header row and centered full-width text.

Navy page, indigo sidebar and panels, white pills with ink text, saturated tiles kept at full strength. A faithful take on the reference's night palette (03). It has the same tile weaknesses as light: modest numerals and generic icon glyphs in white plates.

Navy/indigo night palette carried well onto the phone, with white Refresh pill and saturated tiles. As in light, two stacked chrome rows and an indented greeting beside the disc crowd the first screen, where the reference phone is compact and centered.

Compact blue header band with a clean sag arc, bold white title and one-line lead. In its trailing third sits one tight cluster: a crescent-shaded sun, an overlapping cloud and a tucked pink sparkle, a clear step up from rc.1's scattered stickers and close to 02's composition. Below, a cream panel holds ink/cream dot filter pills and a calm ruled table with status tags.

The band keeps its hue and arc on the phone, and filter pills and the table scroll inside the cream panel. The sun cluster stays near full size (about 180px) in a reserved right column, so the lead wraps beside it instead of running full width the way the reference phone's centered hero does.

Blue band with arc and sun-cloud-sparkle cluster against a navy page, indigo panel, white active pill with ink dot, indigo inactive pills and dark table rows. Coherent with the reference's night band (03), with hierarchy as clear as light.
Night palette holds well on the phone: indigo panel, white active dot pill, dark table rows. As in light, the header-band art keeps a large reserved column and squeezes the lead.

Blue header band with breadcrumb, h2 title, meta line, a white status tag and the same sun cluster; ink/cream dot tabs; a cream panel with a blue cover and a ruled facts row. The structure is right, but the rocket pictogram fills only about a quarter of its cover, and the cover repeats the band's blue directly below it. The reference's plates fill 60–70% and vary hue (07).

On the phone the title breaks to two lines beside the reserved sun column. Below the tabs, a 400px blue cover with a small rocket stacks under the blue band, so two large blue fields share one viewport. The reference keeps one field per phone screen.

Night version of the detail page: blue band on navy, indigo content panel, white active tab. The same under-filled blue cover repeats the band hue, though the indigo panel separates it a little better than cream does.
Navy/indigo phone layout with the blue band and a blue cover in one viewport. The title wraps beside the art column and the rocket sits small in the cover, as in light.

Green header band with arc and a cluster of a crescent-shaded pink disc, an overlapping orange pill and a white sparkle. It differs from the Projects cluster, as the area-hue rule intends. A cream panel holds a ruled people table with category-color avatars and role dots, nothing decorative inside. Close to the reference's restraint around data.
The green band keeps its arc and cluster on the phone, and the table scrolls inside its frame. As on Projects, the art keeps a large reserved column, so the lead wraps to two lines beside it.
Green band on navy, indigo panel and dark table rows with avatars and role dots, white active nav pill. Clean night hierarchy matching 03's tone.
Night phone layout consistent with light: band, arc and cluster intact, with a horizontally scrolling table in an indigo frame. Same oversized art column beside the lead.

findings.summary: Stat tiles undersell the number. Figures are about 32px, little bigger than the label, and each tile's corner carries a white-plated stock-style icon (calendar, clock, rain cloud). The reference's color tiles (08) let a huge bold number dominate under a small eyebrow, with no icon competing.

The phone dashboard opens with two rows of chrome (a nav-pill strip, then search + pill + avatar), and the greeting glyph indents the title into a narrow column. The reference phone keeps one compact header row and full-width centered text.

On the detail page, the item cover holds a small rocket filling about 25% of the cover, in the same blue as the header band above it. On phones that makes two large blue fields in one viewport. The reference's pictograms fill their plates and change hue from their surroundings.

On phones, header-band art keeps a reserved right column at about 180px instead of shrinking or moving below the text. Titles and leads wrap into the left half beside it, where the reference phone gives text the full width.
